why: Re-measurement of the operator-raised critical BL-20260912-BYBIT2-SETTLE-COIN-PAGE-RETURNS-FEWER-POSITIONS-THAN-THE-VENUE-HOLDS-SO-A-REAL-MONEY-HEDGE-BOOK-IS-NEVER-FETCHED-AND-SITS-NAKED, 24h on. Three registers and the generated CLAUDE.md brief; no src/, no config, no workflows, nothing enacted and no live position touched. bybit_2 settle_coin_page returns row_count 2 on 148 of 148 soak rows and ETHUSDT is never read symbol-scoped (0 of 148), against a positive control on bybit_1 where the backfill fires in 105 of 148. Records what CANNOT be established: row_count 2 fits both 'the page omits a book' and 'there are only two now', and no bot surface can tell them apart because they all read through the defective path. Also records that criterion (1) is unreachable from a session -- /api/diag/exchange_positions takes account_id only and silently ignores &symbol=. Clears clause (3) of OI-20260912-BYBIT-SYMBOL-DEDUPE-REPAIRED-AND-NO-FLEET-READ-HAS-BEEN-SEEN-WITHOUT-THE-DROP with its required denominator (two two-sided symbols on the venue, emitted 8 == 8 books) and leaves the row open on clause (4). Files one loud OPEN-ITEMS row, because the critical had none. The Tier-2 fix and the Tier-2 diag parameter are PROPOSED and not taken.
